about_page.title: An agency built for brands that sell desire.
about_page.sub: Born from the industry. Grown with it.
about_page.story: Explore Digital was born from the conviction that hospitality, experience, and real estate brands deserve an agency that truly understands the industry — not one that just applies generic templates. We built our expertise within the universe that demands identity, emotion, and desire.
about_page.story2: We serve brands in Brazil, Portugal, and international Portuguese-speaking markets. Our team is small by choice — we prefer to be strategic partners to few rather than suppliers to many.
about_page.v1_desc: We only work with hospitality, experiences, and real estate. That makes us better at what matters most to you.
about_page.v2_desc: We don't sell impressions. We sell direct bookings, qualified leads, and real measurable growth.
about_page.v3_desc: You know what's being done, why, and what results it's generating — always, no asterisks.
about_page.team_title: A small team. A big impact.
about_page.team_sub: Each client has a dedicated team that understands the business and thinks strategically about growth.

items.description: When someone searches 'guesthouse in [city]', you appear first. And we convert that click into a booking, with measurable ROI on every dollar invested.

items.description: Does your site generate more direct bookings than the commission you pay Booking.com today? Ours does. Sites and landing pages that convert visits into guests.

items.description: Automate follow-ups, check-ins and billing. Your team focuses on the guest, not the spreadsheet. Custom systems and integrations for your operation.

items.title: Branding
items.description: Your brand defines the price you can charge. Premium identities justify premium rates, from naming to the complete visual identity.

about.title: Specialists in what demands identity the most.
about.description: Hospitality, experiences, and real estate are sectors where the brand is the product. We understand this — and we build brands equal to that responsibility.
about.d1_desc: We don't work with e-commerce, startups or retail. Only hotels, guesthouses, real estate and experiences. That makes us the best at what you need. Not the cheapest on the market.
about.d2_desc: Followers who don't book don't pay the bills. Every campaign, post and landing page we deliver is measured by one metric: real growth of your revenue.
about.d3_desc: You don't talk to an intern. You have a fixed team that knows your brand, your season and your ideal client, thinking strategically about growth throughout the year.
about.markets: We work with brands in Brazil and Spain, in Portuguese, English and Spanish.
